agent_explanation: NS green starts ~step 292 and is still green at steps 360,377,480,487 — ~195s continuous, far beyond max_green_seconds=85. The detector_fail on N (active from t=360) blinds the controller to N's queue; actuated gap-out/max-green/recall logic then never terminates NS green despite E waiting 74s at 360 rising to 201s at 487 with queue growing 34 to 74. Without the failure the same demand cycles normally (counterfactual E wait only 11s at 487), so the cause is max-green/recall not enforced while a held-direction detector is failed.
